cat-s-cradle.text: گهوارهٔ گربه چهارمین رمان نویسنده آمریکایی کورت ونه‌گات است که اولین بار در ۱۹۶۳ چاپ شد. این کتاب در مورد علم، تکنولوژی و مذهب بحث می‌کند و در همین حین، مسابقه تسلیحاتی و بسیاری مفاهیم دیگر را به سخره می‌گیرد. دانشگاه شیکاگو بعد از اینکه پایان‌نامه ونه‌گات را در سال ۱۹۴۷ رد کرد، به خاطر این کتاب به او در سال ۱۹۷۱ مدرک افتخاری در رشته انسان‌شناسی داد.

inkheart.text: Inkheart is a 2003 young adult fantasy novel by Cornelia Funke, and is the first book of the Inkheart series, with Inkspell (2005) and Inkdeath (2007) succeeding it. The novel became one of the finalists of 2004 BookSense Book of the Year Award for Children's Literature and won the Flicker Tale Children's Book Award in 2006. Based on a 2007 online poll, the National Education Association listed the book as one of its "Teachers' Top 100 Books for Children".

outlander.text: غریبه مجموعه‌ای از رمان‌های فانتزی تاریخی نوشتهٔ دایانا گابالدون، نویسندهٔ آمریکایی است. گابالدون جلد اول این مجموعه را، با نام غریبه، در اواخر دهه ۱۹۸۰ آغاز کرد و این کتاب در سال ۱۹۹۱ منتشر شد. او نه جلد از ده جلد برنامه ریزی شدهٔ این مجموعه را منتشر کرده است. نهمین رمان از این مجموعه، برو به زنبورها بگو که من رفته‌ام، در ۲۳ نوامبر ۲۰۲۱ منتشر شد.

doomsday-book.text: Doomsday Book is a 1992 science fiction novel by American author Connie Willis. The novel won both the Hugo and Nebula Awards, and was shortlisted for other awards. The title of the book refers to the Domesday Book of 1086. Kivrin Engle, the main character, says that her recording is "a record of life in the Middle Ages, which is what William the Conqueror's survey turned out to be".

dying-inside.text: Dying Inside is a 1972 science fiction novel by American writer Robert Silverberg. It was first serialized in Galaxy in 1972 and published in book form by Charles Scribner's Sons later that year. The novel follows David Selig, a middle-aged telepath in contemporary New York City, as the mind-reading ability that has shaped his life begins to disappear.

the-book-of-skulls.text: The Book of Skulls is a science fiction novel by American writer Robert Silverberg, first published in 1972. It was nominated for the Nebula Award in 1972, and both the Hugo and Locus Awards in 1973.

timequake.text: Timequake is a 1997 semi-autobiographical work by Kurt Vonnegut. Marketed as a novel, the book was described as a "stew" by Vonnegut, in which he summarizes a novel he had been struggling with for a number of years.

pippi-goes-on-board-book.text: Pippi Goes on Board is a 1946 sequel to Swedish writer Astrid Lindgren's classic children's chapter book, Pippi Longstocking. It was followed by a further sequel Pippi in the South Seas. It was filmed in 1969 for a TV series and edited into a film in 1969.
